title: Groups Of Special Equivalent Strings
description:
All strings in `words` have the same length. A move swaps two characters at even indices or swaps two characters at odd indices. Two strings are equivalent if one can be transformed into the other by any number of moves. Return the number of equivalence groups.

## Examples

```text
Input: words = ["abcd", "cdab", "cbad", "xyzz", "zzxy", "zzyx"]
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: words = ["abc", "acb", "bac", "bca", "cab", "cba"]
Output: 3
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= words.length <= 1000`
- `1 <= words[i].length <= 20`
- All words have the same length and contain lowercase English letters.
